# Chaotically Organized AI

COAI helps service businesses nationwide capture inquiries, follow up, and operate customer workflows. Bakersfield and Kern County have a dedicated local acquisition site at https://coaibakersfield.com/.

## Approved offers
- Digital Diagnostic & Repair: $500, with $200 upfront and $300 upon completion of agreed work. Functionality, listings, discoverability and lead-path review, defined priority repairs, and final report.
- COAI Revenue Engine: $1,997 implementation plus $297/month. Conversion-focused site or upgrade, lead capture and CRM, missed-call recovery, follow-up, local search foundation, and defined ongoing management.
- Intelligent Business Infrastructure: $4,997+ implementation plus $597–$997/month. Core revenue system, AI receptionist, custom workflow integration, reporting, and defined monthly optimization.

Existing customer agreements remain unchanged unless separately amended. Third-party subscriptions and ad spend require separate approval. No ranking, lead-volume, or revenue result is guaranteed.
